description: Create one executor line (a member Session) for a task. Call it from a Run whose accepted envelope lists create_member and whose Host binding sets createMember, or from the secretary's request round; the task must belong to your Goal's adopted plan. The platform first looks for a suitable existing line and answers reused when one fits; under every-step confirmation it answers needs_decision with a member-creation card instead of creating; while a creation is still being applied it answers pending. Parameters: duty is always executor, scope names the task, and reason says why a new line is needed (1-2000 UTF-8 bytes).

parameters.duty: Always "executor". This tool creates executor lines only; adviser, scribe and secretary lines are not created here.
parameters.scope: The member's scope; only the task arm is accepted.
parameters.scope.task: The task the new executor line is responsible for.
parameters.scope.task.goalId: The task's goal id; the member belongs to this Goal.
parameters.reason: Why a new executor line is needed; 1-2000 UTF-8 bytes.
